routedFindings.topic: VBAT Cap2 / 稳压 role relay identity is absent from the signed boundary
routedFindings.fact: the Cap2 rule closes the stabilising capacitor of any powered PIN by default (knowledge/standards/relay-checklist.md:25-42, FR-001: 'PIN 加电就需要其 Cap 稳压电容, 默认闭'), with the DALI family listed as K13_VBAT_Cap / K21_VAC_Cap / K0_VCC_Cap / K5_VBUS_Cap. VBAT is powered at 4.2 V for the whole item, so its Cap relay is expected closed; the signed strategy contract's RG-1 closure is empty and records the VBAT Cap2 as UNRESOLVED because no relay in the frozen DALI table carries a Cap name or number (strategy conflict C-04 / open item OI-S-02)
routedFindings.methodImpact: the MP-3 VBAT rail is established without the relay the rule expects; the phases and measurements are otherwise unaffected, and the rail level is verified by the sense leg
routedFindings.note: VAC2 is the swept source, so the same rule removes its Cap rather than closing it; the VAC2 side therefore needs no supplementation
routedFindings.questionForOwner: which frozen relay instance (number and instance name) is the VBAT stabilising capacitor of the DALI board, or is the VBAT Cap relay explicitly waived for TM109?
routedFindings.blockingForCodeWrite: yes for a faithful FR-001 closure set; no for the electrical method itself

routedFindings.topic: the Toggle observation closure for the INT endpoint is empty in the signed boundary
routedFindings.fact: knowledge/standards/toggle-awg-rules.md:34 states that a Toggle observation needs a two-relay closure, naming an INT/SDA observation relay and a pull-up relay; knowledge/hardware/pin-resource-map.md:42-43 names K43_SDA_INT and K58_INT_PU, and relay-checklist.md:60 requires the pull-up relay to be closed for an open-drain observation. The signed strategy contract's RG-3 closure is empty, its functionalRelays record the INT pull-up as UNRESOLVED, and conflict C-04 shows those knowledge-layer names and numbers do not exist in the frozen DALI relay table. The INT pad structure (open-drain versus push-pull) is not asserted by any signed input (knowledge/references/L1-chip/UVLO.md:21)
routedFindings.methodImpact: this item's only measurement is the observation of the INT indicator transition; if the pad is open-drain and no pull-up can be closed, the transition may not be observable and MP-5 to MP-7 cannot produce a valid capture
routedFindings.conditional: closes with no contract change if the pad is proven push-pull; otherwise the pull-up instance must be supplied by the strategy owner and RG-3's closure amended by that owner (this role must not amend it)
routedFindings.questionForOwner: is the INT observation pad push-pull, and if it is open-drain which frozen relay instance provides its pull-up for TM109?
routedFindings.blockingForCodeWrite: yes — the observation closure must be known before the item is coded
